import sys

def install(package):
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", package])

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# Load clinical, mutation, and expression data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', usecols=['bcr_patient_barcode','age_at_diagnosis','gender'])
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', usecols=['patient_id','Hugo_Symbol','Variant_Classification'])
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# Prepare expression data: strip versions and extract patient IDs
expr.index = expr.index.str.split('.').str[0]
expr_patient_ids = [col[:12] for col in expr.columns]
expr.columns = expr_patient_ids

# Identify common patient IDs
clin_ids = set(clin['bcr_patient_barcode'])
mut_ids = set(mut['patient_id'])
expr_ids = set(expr_patient_ids)
common_ids = clin_ids & mut_ids & expr_ids
print(f"Initial expression shape: {expr.shape}")
expr = expr.loc[:, expr.columns.isin(common_ids)]
print(f"Filtered expression to common patients: {expr.shape}")

# Aggregate duplicate columns to patient-level expression
expr_grouped = expr.T.groupby(expr.columns).mean().T
print(f"Aggregated expression shape (genes x patients): {expr_grouped.shape}")

# Label BRAF mutation status
braf_mut_ids = set(
    mut.loc[
        (mut['Hugo_Symbol']=='BRAF') & (mut['Variant_Classification']=='Missense_Mutation'),
        'patient_id'
    ]
)
status_df = pd.DataFrame({'patient_id': sorted(common_ids)})
status_df['BRAF_status'] = status_df['patient_id'].map(
    lambda x: 'Mutant' if x in braf_mut_ids else 'WildType'
)
print("\nBRAF status group counts:")
print(status_df['BRAF_status'].value_counts())

# Map MAPK genes to Ensembl IDs
genes = ['BRAF','RAF1','MAPK1','MAPK3','MAP2K1','MAP2K2']
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    install('mygene')
    import mygene
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
res = mg.querymany(genes, scopes='symbol', fields='ensembl.gene', species='human')
map_dict = {}
for entry in res:
    g = entry['query']
    ens = entry.get('ensembl', {}).get('gene') if 'ensembl' in entry else entry.get('ensembl.gene')
    if isinstance(ens, list): ens = ens[0]
    map_dict[g] = ens
mapped = {g: map_dict.get(g) for g in genes}
print("\nGene to Ensembl mapping:")
for g, e in mapped.items(): print(f"  {g}: {e}")
ens_ids = [e for e in mapped.values() if e and e in expr_grouped.index]
print(f"Ensembl IDs present in data: {ens_ids}")

# Compute MAPK signature score per patient
mapk_expr = expr_grouped.loc[ens_ids]
mapk_score = mapk_expr.mean(axis=0).reset_index()
mapk_score.columns = ['patient_id','MAPK_score']
print(f"\nComputed MAPK scores for {len(mapk_score)} patients")

# Merge data
clin2 = clin.rename(columns={'bcr_patient_barcode':'patient_id'})
df = pd.merge(mapk_score, status_df, on='patient_id')
df = pd.merge(df, clin2, on='patient_id').dropna(subset=['MAPK_score','age_at_diagnosis','gender'])
print(f"Merged analysis DataFrame shape: {df.shape}\n")

# Group statistics and t-test
counts = df['BRAF_status'].value_counts()
means = df.groupby('BRAF_status')['MAPK_score'].mean()
mut_s = df.loc[df['BRAF_status']=='Mutant','MAPK_score']
wt_s = df.loc[df['BRAF_status']=='WildType','MAPK_score']
t_stat, p_val = ttest_ind(mut_s, wt_s, equal_var=False, nan_policy='omit')
print("Patient counts by BRAF status:")
print(counts)
print("\nGroup means of MAPK signature scores:")
print(means)
print(f"\nT-test (Mutant vs WildType): t = {t_stat:.3f}, p = {p_val:.3g}\n")

# Regression adjusting for covariates
df['gender'] = df['gender'].astype('category')
model = smf.ols('MAPK_score ~ C(BRAF_status) + age_at_diagnosis + C(gender)', data=df).fit()
coef = model.params.get('C(BRAF_status)[T.Mutant]', np.nan)
pval = model.pvalues.get('C(BRAF_status)[T.Mutant]', np.nan)
print("Regression result for BRAF_status effect (Mutant vs WildType):")
print(f"  Coefficient = {coef:.3f}, p-value = {pval:.3g}\n")

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.boxplot(x='BRAF_status', y='MAPK_score', data=df, palette='Set2')
plt.title('MAPK Signature by BRAF Mutation Status')
plt.xlabel('BRAF Status')
plt.ylabel('Mean MAPK Pathway Expression')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
